femorotibijalnog zgloba uz vidljiv opsežan subhondralni edem lateralnog platoa tibije koji je
deniveliran u sklopu OA promjena (hondromalacija IV. stupnja).
adjudication_history.rationale: Nearly complete reduction of lateral cartilage thickness establishes depth, but no measured or explicitly diffuse/entire loss area. Extensive adjective describes marrow edema, not cartilage extent; reader regional P inference preserved.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Lamelarno tekućine infrapatelarno.
adjudication_history.rationale: Correct preread after full reread: infrapatellar lamellar fluid, peri-ITB loculation and tendon-adjacent fluid are extraarticular/localized descriptions without actual joint effusion assessment. Preserve missing rather than uncertain intraarticular fluid.

adjudication_history.source_quote:
Ill-defined hyperintense articular cartilage with small surface defect, about 4mm.,at the lateral  
 patellar facet with subchondral bone edema noted.
adjudication_history.rationale: Four-mm patellar cartilage defect is below qualifying extent locally; report never assesses trochlear cartilage, so entire PF target cannot be negative. Preserve reader local-defect-to-whole-compartment inference.

adjudication_history.source_quote: There is diffuse high grade and low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
adjudication_history.rationale: Retain preread: diffuse high/low-grade loss with explicit >50% depth across medial opposing articular regions supports qualitative extensive deep disease. Reader deep-component-contiguity concern remains global semantic QA dissent.

adjudication_history.source_quote: The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial and lateral trochleas, medial and lateral patellar facets.
adjudication_history.rationale: Diffuse mixed PF loss explicitly includes >50% cartilage thickness on trochlear and patellar surfaces, supporting qualitative broad-region P; preserve reader more restrictive region requirement.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of hte right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes.
adjudication_history.rationale: Degenerative subchondral edema/cysts do not specifically mention fracture; M retained.

adjudication_history.source_quote: There is mild generalized thinning of the medial and lateral compartment articular cartilage, more so medially.

adjudication_history.rationale: Mild generalized lateral cartilage thinning is direct below-threshold structural degree. Retain N with reader U dissent for semantic QA.
